meta.name: apex-recon
meta.description: Engineering lead reconnaissance — inventory the project before planning. Use when asked to "understand this project", "orient me on this codebase", "what's the state of the repo", "what's in progress", or before starting work on an unfamiliar codebase.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速盘点项目状态，了解代码库全貌
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开始开发前快速理解一个不熟悉的代码库。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly inventory project state and understand the codebase before planning.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly get up to speed with an unfamiliar codebase before starting work.

howto.what: 装好后，当你要了解项目时，Claude 会化身工程主管，扫描代码库，列出技术栈、目录结构、活跃分支、待办事项、测试和文档状态，最后输出一份 40 行内的 CLI 报告，超长时自动生成 HTML 报告。
howto.when: 当你要求“了解这个项目”、“熟悉代码库”、“项目当前状态”或开始处理陌生代码库时触发。

say.text: 帮我了解这个项目的结构和技术栈。
say.note: Claude 会扫描项目并输出结构摘要。

say.text: 给我一份项目当前状态报告。
say.note: Claude 会盘点活跃工作和健康信号。

say.text: 梳理一下这个代码库的待办事项和分支。
say.note: Claude 会列出 TODO 和分支信息。

howto.what_en: When you ask to understand a project, Claude acts as an engineering lead, scans the codebase, lists tech stack, directory structure, active work, TODOs, test and doc status, then outputs a CLI report (max 40 lines) or an HTML report if too long.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'understand this project', 'orient me on this codebase', 'what\'s the state of the repo', or before working on an unfamiliar codebase.

say_en.text: Help me understand the structure and tech stack of this project.
say_en.note: Claude scans and outputs a structural summary.

say_en.text: Give me a current status report of the project.
say_en.note: Claude inventories active work and health signals.

say_en.text: List the TODOs and branches in this codebase.
say_en.note: Claude identifies TODO comments and branch info.
